meaning: For this integrated Work, the accountable Lead may make, record and report the final AcceptanceDecision only after every agreed both-runtime criterion passes and independent review is complete. Purpose or scope changes require actual user decisions. This delegates the acceptance procedure; it is not a current acceptance verdict, implementation Plan adoption, deployment/runtime permission or a renewed native model budget.
